name: claude-starter
description: A small, opinionated user-level Claude Code setup.

plugins.name: starter
plugins.description: Working rules, safe parallel fan-out, safe worktree cleanup, a monthly review; context7 and obscura MCP offered by setup.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Optional, third party, not part of the starter (ayghri/i-have-adhd, MIT): action-first output - the next step first, numbered steps, no tangents.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Optional, third party, not part of the starter (DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT): lazy-senior-dev mode - reuse what exists, stdlib first, the smallest code that works, plus /ponytail-review and a cost band.
